subject: alligator snapping turtle
title: This 200-Pound Turtle Fishes With a Fake Worm Growing on Its Tongue

scenes.text: This turtle has a fishing lure growing inside its mouth.
The alligator snapping turtle is one of the largest freshwater turtles, up to about 200 pounds.
It lies perfectly still on the river bottom, mouth wide open, looking like a log.
Inside, its tongue has a pink appendage shaped like a worm, and the turtle can wiggle it at will.
A fish swims in to grab the free meal. The jaws close on it.
It can live up to 70 years, and it still falls for none of its own tricks.

description:
The alligator snapping turtle lies motionless on the bottom of rivers with its mouth open and wiggles a worm-shaped appendage on its tongue to lure fish in.
Males can weigh up to about 200 pounds, and the species can live up to about 70 years.
Would you notice it before it noticed you?
